snapshot.nextjs-advisories: [2026-07-13] Newest still the May 6-7 2026 coordinated batch (10 GHSAs incl. GHSA-26hh-7cqf-hhc6 follow-up, GHSA-c4j6-fc7j-m34r SSRF via WebSocket upgrade, GHSA-wfc6-r584-vfw7 cache poisoning) — already ticketed as BIN-213. Nothing published after 2026-05-07.
snapshot.ghsa-npm: [2026-07-13] No Next.js/React/Firebase JS SDK/firebase-functions advisories in the current feed. Prior transitive-dep CVEs (protobufjs CVE-2026-41242, fast-xml-parser CVE-2026-25128) remain non-issues — Binge's resolved lockfile versions (protobufjs 7.6.4/7.5.6, fast-xml-parser 5.7.2) are already past the fix versions; unchanged since last scan.
snapshot.firebase-js-sdk-releases: [2026-07-13] New release firebase@12.16.0 (2026-07-09, up from 12.15.0/2026-06-16). Notable: @firebase/app-check@0.12.0 lets initializeAppCheck() omit an explicit provider (auto-inits ReCaptchaEnterpriseProvider from recaptchaSiteKey) + fixes an Auth/AppCheck ReCAPTCHA-Enterprise init conflict; @firebase/auth@1.13.3 changes the auth API request referrer policy from no-referrer to strict-origin-when-cross-origin (to support HTTP-Referrer-restricted API keys). Checked against src/lib/firebase/appCheck.ts: Binge already passes an explicit provider (new ReCaptchaV3Provider(siteKey), not Enterprise) so neither App Check change applies; the Auth referrer-policy change is additive/non-breaking (no code change needed, picked up on next dependency bump). Non-actionable — no ticket filed. Binge's installed version remains 12.12.1 (^12.12.1 range).
snapshot.firestore-rules-relnotes: [2026-07-13] Page's own 'last updated' still 2026-01-21 — unchanged since last scan. No rules-language change this cycle. (WebFetch 403'd; WebSearch fallback used.)
snapshot.recaptcha-enterprise-relnotes: [2026-07-13] No v3-breaking change found this cycle; WebSearch surfaced only pre-existing context (deprecated RecaptchaAction params pending a future major, site-key-mismatch exception behavior) — neither is new or affects Binge's current usage. (WebFetch 403'd; WebSearch fallback used.)
snapshot.gh-changelog-dependabot: [2026-07-13] New July-2026 entry: GitHub Advanced Security enterprise customers can publish internal ('innersource') security advisories restricted to enterprise-owned repos, with a new REST endpoint + Dependabot alerts/PRs for affected internal repos. Doesn't apply to Binge (not a GHAS-enterprise/innersource repo) — non-actionable. (WebFetch 403'd; WebSearch fallback used.)
